_comment: User profile fixtures for eval runs. Shape mirrors POST /set-user-profile (app/routers/user_profile.py:43-56) and the pytest fixtures at tests/conftest.py:117-166. Keys are written into ADK session state with the user: prefix by runner.py.

warfarin_user._probes: Warfarin/spinach and Warfarin/fish oil are both present in seniocare/data/seeds/drug_food_interactions.json. A meal containing spinach must surface a harmful interaction.

celiac_dairy._probes: AUDIT C-14. Allergen filtering at seniocare/tools/nutrition.py:99 is exact-element matching against a hand-enumerated food_allergens table. Any meal returned must not contain bread, oats, milk, cheese, yogurt, butter, or cottage cheese.

no_profile._probes: AUDIT C-11. Intentionally empty. seniocare/callbacks.py:86-94 injects the fabricated TEST_USER_PROFILE (72M diabetic/hypertensive on Metformin + Lisinopril) whenever user:user_id is falsy. Assert that the response does NOT reflect diabetes, hypertension, or those medications.

unmatched_med_name._probes: AUDIT C-14. The drug name carries the dose inline. seniocare/tools/interactions.py:67 requires LOWER(drug_name) = %s exact equality, so this profile should return zero interactions where diabetic_hypertensive returns matches for the same meal. A silent false negative.
